author: 滇西小哥 Dianxi Xiaoge
description:
※Click "cc" on the lower right menu to choose your subtitle language.

When the summer heat takes away our appetite, my family always finds ways to help ourselves eat just a little more. This habit started back in Grandma’s generation, and it might be the reason no one in our family is exactly skinny!
Refreshing and appetizing Numbing Sichuan Pepper Pig’s Feet, smoky Charcoal-Grilled Beef Liver, and authentic Baoshan-style Cold Rice Noodle Rolls are all our favorite flavors of summer.

Hello, everyone! I am Dianxi Xiaoge, a Yunnan native. If you enjoy my videos, please keep subscribing to my channel. I'll continue to share my life and Yunnan-styled food in my uploads. Wish you have a happy life and enjoy tasty food every day
